title: Scheduled layer health (pg_cron)
notes: Wraps scripts/cron-health-check.mjs's runCronHealthCheck()/evaluateCronHealth() over the 7 EXPECTED_CRON_JOBS (scripts/lib/cron-health.mjs) — the same verdict logic the nightly cron-health.yml workflow gates on, not a second copy of it. Needs BENCH_PROD_READONLY_URL (falls back to CRON_CHECK_DATABASE_URL) — the postgres-role read-only connection string; cron.job and BackgroundJob are invisible to the vq_app role (F63 class). pending_background_jobs is info (no floor): see D4 in .claude/MEMORY.md for the disposition of the pending BackgroundJob rows, which is an owner call, not a benchmark floor.
